scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r public/. dist/ && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run lint
scripts.lint: pnpm run build && NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1 web-ext lint --source-dir dist
scripts.start: pnpm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist
scripts.test: rm -rf dist-test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/*.test.js
